milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find/observe a torch in a dark room. The wall torch is at spawn-relative (3, 2, 5), attached to the cobblestone wall partition with a stone brick support block. Horizontal distance from spawn is ~5.83 blocks, so max_distance=5 ensures the player must actually walk forward (~1 block minimum) before the milestone triggers. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the torch, confirming they have visually located it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find/observe the trapped chest hidden in an alcove. The trapped chest is at spawn-relative (8, 1, 11), behind stone brick walls with 1x2 doorway openings. Horizontal distance from spawn is ~13.6 blocks, so max_distance=5 requires the player to navigate deep into the room through the wall openings. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the chest, confirming they have found it in the alcove.
